title: Canvases Feature and Tiled Layout
description: Cursor 3.1 introduced Canvases - interactive visualizations including dashboards and custom interfaces with tables, boxes, diagrams, and charts. Also added tiled layout for parallel agent management, upgraded voice input with batch STT, branch selection in empty state, and diff-to-file navigation.

title: Windsurf 2.0 with Devin Integration and Agent Command Center
description: Windsurf 2.0 launched with Devin cloud agent integration available in every self-serve plan. Features include Agent Command Center (Kanban-style view for local and cloud agents), refined Windsurf Browser with Cascade tool, improved .gitignore/.codeiumignore handling, and stability improvements for remote extensions.

title: Copilot Cloud Agent, GPT-5.4 Mini GA, and SDK Public Preview
description: GitHub released Copilot cloud agent for research, planning, and coding tasks. GPT-5.4 mini is now generally available. Copilot SDK entered public preview. New features include organization runner controls for cloud agent, Copilot CLI BYOK support with local models, and usage metrics identifying active/passive code review users.

title: Enterprise Features, Devin Review Auto-Fix, and Light Mode
description: Devin released multiple enterprise features including scoped secrets, ACU visibility control, MCP registry enforcement, and build pinning. Added Devin Review Auto-Fix button, PR Review Chat CI tools, and focus mode (Cmd+Shift+F). Introduced Light Mode (beta), streaming shell output in worklog, and sessions API enhancements.

title: Version 0.86.0 - GPT-5 and Grok-4 Support
description: Aider v0.86.0 added support for all GPT-5 models and Grok-4 via xAI and OpenRouter. Added Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite Preview model, Kimi K2 model support, and model announcements display. Fixed issues with model settings replacement and improved PostHog analytics. Aider wrote 88% of the code in this release.

title: Version 1.3.38 - Configs Support and Session History Filtering
description: Continue v1.3.38 added .continue/configs support for multiple configuration files, filter session history by workspace directory, and config.yaml existence validation. Dependency updates including happy-dom, handlebars, and brace-expansion security fixes.
